description: How a source text and an optional context form the key a translation is stored under, looked up by, and reported under in usage analytics. The same key is what `POST /translate` bodies split back into `key` and `context`.

cases.name: context is copied verbatim, spaces and punctuation included
a key that already contains a double underscore is not escaped
the key function does not trim (the component path trims before calling it)
